newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cactus row may halt tequila production.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cactus row may halt tequila production.

text.p: Mexico's debtors' organization "El Barzon" is blockading the town of Tequila with sticks and stones in a dispute over raw material prices that could halt production of the world-famous drink made there, regional media reported on Thursday.

Barzon supporters are refusing access to trucks carrying agave cactus, from which tequila is distilled, in protest at distillers refusing to pay higher prices to growers due to a glut in supply, said the Siglo 21 and El Occidental dailies.
Tequila makers have agave stocks sufficient for just two or three days, said El Occidental, so the blockade may soon halt production, they added.
El Barzon is involved in the dispute as some of the growers have joined the nationwide debtors' movement.
The dispute between cactus growers and distillers erupted several months ago.
